rows.label: Real estate transfer tax
rows.value: None: the Arizona Constitution bars new real property sale or transfer taxes
rows.note: Applies to the state, counties, cities and districts; fees or taxes already in existence on December 31, 2007 are not affected.

sections.title: Arizona sales and use tax

rows.label: State sales tax rate
rows.note: Transaction privilege tax (TPT), retail classification: 5% (A.R.S. 42-5010) plus the 0.6% education increment (A.R.S. 42-5010.01). Arizona taxes the seller's privilege of doing business (TPT) rather than levying a sales tax on the buyer. The 0.6% increment runs to 30 June 2041.

source.title: A.R.S. 42-5010: Rates; distribution base

rows.label: County sales tax
rows.value: Counties with fewer than 1.5 million people may levy a county general excise tax, collected by the Department of Revenue
rows.note: Cities and towns also levy their own privilege taxes; that authority is not quoted here.

source.title: A.R.S. 42-6103: County general excise tax; authority to levy; rate

rows.label: Groceries (food for home consumption)
rows.note: Deducted from the retail tax base: food, under the conditions of article 3 and A.R.S. 42-5074 and 42-6017.

source.title: A.R.S. 42-5061: Retail classification; definitions

rows.label: Prescription drugs
rows.note: Deducted from the retail tax base: drugs and medical oxygen prescribed by a licensed medical, dental or veterinary professional.

source.title: A.R.S. 42-5061: Retail classification; definitions

rows.label: Use tax rate
rows.note: Taxable purchases on which no sales tax was paid (storage, use or consumption in the state). Use tax at the A.R.S. 42-5010 retail rate (5%) plus the 0.6% increment through 30 June 2041.

source.title: A.R.S. 42-5155: Levy of tax; tax rate; purchaser's liability (use tax)

rows.label: Remote sellers: sales threshold
rows.note: Remote seller's gross proceeds from sales to Arizona customers not facilitated by a marketplace, previous or current calendar year: must pay the tax above this amount.
